title: ios-acceptance-simulator
responsibility: Owns the ios-acceptance-simulator build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: install.udid
inputs.description: UDID of the simulator that receives the app installation.

inputs.name: install.product
inputs.description: Path to the app product passed to xcrun simctl install.

inputs.name: launch.udid
inputs.description: UDID of the simulator on which the app is launched.

inputs.name: launch.args
inputs.description: Arguments passed through to the app at launch after the existing process is terminated.

inputs.name: cameraAccess.udid
inputs.description: UDID of the simulator whose camera permission is changed.

inputs.name: cameraAccess.access
inputs.description: Camera permission state that the simulator reports to the app.

inputs.name: running.udid
inputs.description: UDID of the simulator whose process list is checked for the app.

inputs.name: screenshot.udid
inputs.description: UDID of the simulator whose screen is captured.

inputs.name: screenshot.file
inputs.description: Filesystem path where the simulator screenshot is written.

inputs.name: inspectorSocket.udid
inputs.description: UDID of the simulator whose WebKit inspector socket setting is read.

inputs.name: keychainGroups.udid
inputs.description: UDID of the simulator whose Keychain database is queried for matching access groups.

inputs.name: shutdown.udid
inputs.description: UDID of the simulator that is asked to shut down.

outputs.name: deviceName
outputs.description: Name reserved for the native acceptance simulator.

outputs.name: bundleId
outputs.description: Bundle identifier used when launching the app and changing its camera permission.

outputs.name: acceptanceDevice
outputs.description: The simulator UDID and runtime version after the named device has been erased, booted, and boot-checked.

outputs.name: install
outputs.description: No value is returned after the app product is installed on the selected simulator.

outputs.name: launch
outputs.description: No value is returned after the app is launched with the supplied arguments.

outputs.name: cameraAccess
outputs.description: No value is returned after the simulator camera permission state is set for the app.

outputs.name: running
outputs.description: Whether the simulator process list contains the app UIKitApplication entry.

outputs.name: screenshot
outputs.description: No value is returned after the simulator screenshot command is run for the requested path.

outputs.name: inspectorSocket
outputs.description: The value of the simulator RWI_LISTEN_SOCKET environment variable.

outputs.name: keychainGroups
outputs.description: Distinct Keychain access-group names containing the app bundle identifier; item contents are never read.

outputs.name: shutdown
outputs.description: No value is returned after a shutdown attempt for the selected simulator.

errors.name: Simulator runtime, device, or Keychain failure
errors.description: Thrown when no available iOS runtime exists, the newest available runtime supports no iPhone, the Keychain database read fails, or a simulator command fails.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown if the JSON returned while listing simulator runtimes or devices cannot be parsed.

outputs.name: acceptanceDevice
outputs.description: The simulator UDID and runtime version after the named device has been erased, booted, and boot-checked.

errors.name: No supported iOS simulator runtime or device
errors.description: Thrown when no available iOS runtime exists or the newest available runtime supports no iPhone.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown if the JSON returned while listing simulator runtimes or devices cannot be parsed.
